title: Kanpur Plywood Factory Hopes to Save Big on Power Bills with Rooftop Solar
summary: After the residential sector, industrial installations accounted for the second-highest share of India’s 3.8 GW of rooftop solar capacity additions in the second quarter of 2026, according to Mercom’s Q2 and 1H 2026 India Rooftop Solar Market Report. The assurance of regular power supply at affordable costs has been pushing the commercial and industrial (C&I) sector towards rooftop solar projects, especially factories which depend on continuous power for efficient production.

direction_reasons: CAPACITY_EXPANSION cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
